author: TeIq
content: APPROVE. Independent evidence floor green: 4/4 firehose_reconnect tests pass in 4.38s (well under 30s AC-9 budget). Critical production-code finding: FirehoseWorker's main select! had a latent cancel-safety bug — firehose.next_event() is not cancel-safe during connect-phase backoff. The 100ms flush cadence dropped the connect sleep on every poll, starving the connection forever. Fix: pump-task pattern (proto-blue Firehose owned by spawned task, events forwarded over bounded mpsc; worker's select! now over cancel-safe channel recv + flush timer + cancel token). AC-9 binding now holds: post-reconnect events all carry seq > 8, persisted cursor matches disconnect point, exactly 2 connections in 4.38s. Fixture uses proto_blue_ws::frame::MessageFrame::encode() correctly — the original 0-events symptom was the worker-side starvation, not the wire format.
